name: HiPhO
intro: HiPhO基准测试通过高中物理奥林匹克竞赛题目评估(M)LLM的物理能力。它包含13套最新的奥林匹克竞赛试题，涵盖从纯文本到图表题的混合模态。该基准测试采用官方评分方案进行答案和步骤级别的细粒度评分，并根据官方奖牌阈值向模型授予金、银、铜牌，以便与人类参赛者进行直接比较。
org: Shanghai AI Lab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
metric: Exam score, Gold, Silver, Bronze medals
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 过程评估, 人机对比, 多模态
intro_en: The HiPhO benchmark evaluates (M)LLMs' physics abilities using high school physics Olympiad problems. It includes 13 sets of the latest Olympiad questions, covering mixed modalities from pure text to graphical problems. The benchmark applies the official scoring scheme for fine-grained evaluation at both answer and solution step levels, awarding gold, silver, and bronze medals to models based on official medal thresholds for direct comparison with human participants.
metric_en: Exam score, Gold, Silver, Bronze medals

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.07894. HiPhO collects official 2024-2025 Olympiad PDF exam papers from Olympiad websites, converts them to markdown with OCR while preserving LaTeX, matches problems to answers by question index, and manually verifies every QA pair. Experts fix OCR errors, mismatches, and answer inconsistencies. For exams with official marking schemes, step-level criteria are extracted into model-readable rubrics, then verified QAs are refined for context, question structure, and unit clarity. The benchmark covers 13 exam papers, 360 problems, 519 subquestions, 5 physics fields, and 4 modality types. Evaluation combines answer-level and step-level grading based on official marking schemes, computes exam scores, and maps scores to official medal thresholds.
